findings.text: tile_side now sizes a pair batch as 2 * tile_side rather than a target-by-source tile, so a caller selecting tile geometry silently selects a batch length instead; inspect_radial_carrier.py:115 still passes tile_side=64 expecting the old meaning.

the near/distant grouping that took the diverted 16-point wall from 32.177 s to 4.247 s (logs/grouped-probe.log) is guarded by no test, so deleting the group split keeps the suite green while restoring most of the cost.

the batching and worker pool duplicate a capability nova/biot/polygonanalytic.py:2209 already owns, but with a hardcoded ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=4) that ignores the granted CPU set the owner sizes from, and the near/distant predicate at :74 is a second copy of polygonanalytic.py:2084-2092.

the table caption calls the base arm a scratch archive of a806edfa1, but logs/final-negative-control.log records a scratch checkout of bb7a2d7c0 with only coupling_build.py taken from the base revision, so the recorded provenance names a tree that did not produce those rows.

item_verdicts.manifest: read; it states 22 passes at base and 24 at head with zero added failures, names both paired suite logs, and records the negative control that reddens the guard test.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the manifest's declared paths (coupling_build.py, tests/test_coupling_build.py, the evidence fragment and a figures directory); every path in the diff is one of the first three.
